description: This file contains utility methods used by generated serialization code within the Orleans framework, specifically for service resolution, type handling, and serialization helpers.

classes.name: OrleansGeneratedCodeHelper
classes.description: A static utility class providing helper methods for generated serialization code in Orleans, including service resolution, type handling, and serialization helpers.

nested_classes.name: RecursiveServiceResolutionState
nested_classes.description: A private class maintaining service resolution state per thread, tracking call depth and callers for unwrapping services.

nested_classes.name: ExceptionCopier<T, B>
nested_classes.description: An abstract base class implementing deep copying for exception types to support serialization.

methods.name: GetService
methods.description: Unwraps and retrieves a service of type TService from the service provider, handling nested wrappers and call context.

methods.name: UnwrapService
methods.description: Unwraps a given service instance to its core value, ignoring wrappers, with call context considerations.

methods.name: TryGetService
methods.description: Tries to find a caller in the current call stack that matches a specific service type.

methods.name: GetOptionalCopier
methods.description: Returns the provided copier if it is not shallow-copyable; otherwise, returns null.

methods.name: InvokableThrowArgumentOutOfRange
methods.description: Throws an ArgumentOutOfRangeException with a standardized message for invalid argument indexes.

methods.name: ConsumeEndBaseOrEndObject
methods.description: Consumes the end of a base object or object in serialization, expecting specific wire types.

methods.name: ConsumeUnexpectedContent
methods.description: Reads and discards unknown or unexpected serialization fields.

methods.name: SerializeUnexpectedType
methods.description: Serializes a value when its type is unexpected or unknown in the current serialization context.

methods.name: DeserializeUnexpectedType
methods.description: Deserializes a value of an unexpected or unknown type during deserialization.

methods.name: GetMethodInfoOrDefault
methods.description: Finds and returns a MethodInfo matching specified name, generic parameters, and argument types, searching recursively through interface hierarchy.
